# AKG ALGO

> AKG ALGO sells ready-made trading robots for MetaTrader 4 and 5 with one-time licenses. Signal Room subscriptions are sold separately by cycle.

## Products

- [Trading Robots](https://akgalgo.com/bots): Browse MetaTrader Expert Advisors and their requirements.
- [Signal Plans](https://akgalgo.com/pricing): See current Signal Room tiers, cycle dates, and prices.
- [Signal Room](https://akgalgo.com/signals): View the desk schedule and access options.
